structs.name: ParticleData

Lower bound 92: the last ParticleData access is the qword at +84 (`*(QWORD*)(v11+500)=0`). No state access at record +508..+511 in InitParticleData, ParticleState::UpdateInternal, ParticleEmitter::Update, ParticleEmitter::ParticleStateData::ProcessUpdateModules, ParticleState::Update_GeoTrails, ParticleState_SpawnRecordsAndUpdate, ParticleEmitter::EmitParticles, ParticleEmitter::ProcessInstancePool (displacement scans). BuildParticleOffsetTable@0x141BA23C0 reads `*(DWORD*)(this+80)` as the field mask (`HIDWORD(FieldDescriptor) & this+80`); InitParticleData: `*(DWORD*)(v11+496) = *(moduleDef+144)`; ParticleData::Init: `*(DWORD*)(this+80) = poolSize`

method 6 above (state stride 512, ParticleData at state+416); whole-struct rebuild, so a proposal: not applied

structs.notes: Replay ParticleData is 96 bytes: a 24-byte header (pointer, running/delayed/max counts, stride word, local client byte), the 56-byte offset table at +24, flags at +80 and an 8-byte pad at +84. The game-test pEmitter pair is not in Replay. Consistent with game-test minus 16. Proposal: rebuild as the 96-byte layout above; by-value parent ParticleState is not in IDA.
